texts.label: A
texts.title: City Car Club — how it works

paragraphs.text: Members of the City Car Club can book a car by the hour or by the day using the club’s app. Cars are parked in 12 reserved spaces around the city, each marked with a green sign.
Joining costs £30, which includes a check of your driving licence. To join, you must be at least 21 years old and have held a full licence for two years.

The hourly price includes fuel, insurance and parking in the reserved spaces. If the fuel tank is less than a quarter full at the end of your booking, please refill it using the fuel card kept in the car.
Cars must be returned to the same space they were taken from. A charge of £25 is made if a car is returned late without warning.
Please report any damage in the app before you start your journey. Members who fail to do so may be held responsible for it.

texts.label: B
texts.title: Southgate College — enrolling for evening classes

paragraphs.text: Enrolment for spring courses opens on 5 January. Places are limited, so we advise you to enrol early. You can enrol online or in person at the college reception.
Course fees must be paid in full when you enrol. Learners who receive certain benefits may be able to study for free; please bring a recent letter confirming your benefits.
If a course has fewer than eight learners one week before it starts, it may be cancelled. In this case, you will be offered a place on another course or a full refund.
Learners must attend at least 80 per cent of classes to receive a certificate.
Parking at the college is free after 6 pm, and learners can also use the library and computer rooms during their course. A café on the ground floor is open until 8 pm on weekdays.
If you cannot attend a class, please tell your tutor by email so that any handouts can be kept for you.
